headline: Colombian CDTs Signal Persistently High Yields as Central Bank Rate Holds at 12.25%
summary: Following the central bank's policy rate holding at 12.25%, analysts note that Certificate of Deposit (CDT) yields are expected to remain high in the short term, though long-term offerings may adjust if rate cuts are anticipated.
why: Certificate of Deposit yields reflect prevailing monetary policy and dictate retail savings and lending rates in Colombia.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Interest rate environment maintains high deposit yields.
